annotations.text:
HOW TO READ THIS:
gray dashed boxes = to-be-built elements (placeholders, not final art).
Caveat-font text = my callouts/notes.
real color only appears on the Moodboard — everything else stays grayscale on purpose.
Feedback wanted: does the 40% glitch feel like the right peak moment, or should it hit earlier/later in the scroll?
Feedback wanted: nav is just a floating wordmark + text CTA, no bar. OK, or want something more substantial (menu, socials)?
Feedback wanted: warm keynote → neon cyberpunk → deep space arc, or prefer a different emotional curve (e.g. corporate blue throughout, brighter finale)?
